name: Sengakuji
tagline: Shinagawa in 2 minutes and Toranomon in 15 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000.
summary: The station is in Minato City, where Keikyu and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 18 minutes to Otemachi, 27 minutes to Shinjuku, 20 minutes to Shibuya and 2 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. The station stands 4 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 24.6 m. The land around the station rises and falls sharply.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 4 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 1.9 m to 26.5 m, a difference of 24.6 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 3 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 2 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 6 clinics and 7 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 桜十字白金リハビリテーション病院, about 17 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 厚生会古川橋病院, about 18 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Keikyu Main Line and Toei Asakusa Line. The lines are split between operators (Keikyu runs 1 line and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Toei Asakusa Line runs at 123% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 本所吾妻橋→浅草, which this station is not on. Keikyu Main Line runs at 120%. Its busiest stretch is 戸部→横浜, which this station is likewise not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 1K ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. 1LDK ¥240,000 to ¥250,000 and 2LDK ¥370,000 to ¥380,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the high side. For One room, 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For quiet, Takanawa-Gateway; for how close the centre is, Sengakuji.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Sengakuji. Takanawa-Gateway has the JR Yamanote Line and JR Keihin-Tohoku Line, a different set from Sengakuji. To Shibuya, for instance, Takanawa-Gateway takes 8 minutes longer. A one-room flat costs about ¥11,000 more at Takanawa-Gateway. On quiet, Takanawa-Gateway comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: For lower rent, Shirokane-Takanawa; for how close the centre is, Sengakuji.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Sengakuji. Shirokane-Takanawa has the Tokyo Metro Namboku Line and Toei Mita Line, a different set from Sengakuji. To Shinagawa, for instance, Shirokane-Takanawa takes 17 minutes longer. A one-room flat costs about ¥6,000 less at Shirokane-Takanawa. On safety, Shirokane-Takanawa comes out ahead.

noiseSources: 第一京浜 (3 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road
高輪麻布線 (3 lanes each way) runs just outside the station. Traffic on it never stops

leads.terrain: The ground around the station rises and falls sharply, and living above or below the slope changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 7 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 5 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are very lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
